authority.own_null: analysis/SAEA-SLURP-B0-REPLICATE-PAIRED-ANALYSIS-V1/README.md; docs/results/2026-09-17-slurp-b0-review-off-redecision-v2.md -- h_SLU 1.1218 pp and h_intent 1.0051 pp at CI95 on this exact roster and geometry

cell_kind: EFFICIENCY -- the efficiency tables are the deliverable; the paired score read is a non-inferiority guard
claim_boundary: Descriptive paired read on historically exposed TRAIN Fold A discovery rows, plus a cost measurement of the same flight. No superiority, generalization, component-causal, bar or confirmatory claim; no cross-carrier claim; no geometry claim.

contacts.note: this READ makes no contact: it works from the two sealed score artifacts, the sealed per-row outputs, the sealed traces and receipts, and the resident session's own server.log and monitor.jsonl, all read read-only. The one official score of the EFF-1 arm is produced by its own campaign at finalize, not by this read.

decision_rule.HARMFUL: owner decision 25's Method B form, read FIRST: a MEASURED LOSS on either guard -- a point estimate of official pooled SLU micro F1 or of intent (joint scenario+action) accuracy below -h (-1.1218 / -1.0051), or a CI95 UPPER bound below zero. An interval that straddles zero with the point estimate inside the margin is NOT harmful.
decision_rule.NEUTRAL: BOTH guards are non-inferior at the own-null margins: the CI95 LOWER bound of the paired official pooled SLU-F1 delta exceeds -1.1218 AND the CI95 LOWER bound of the paired intent delta exceeds -1.0051. Where an interval straddles zero the verdict states 'non-inferiority proven, superiority not claimed' in those words.
decision_rule.NOT_EVALUABLE: if either guard's interval is so wide that its CI95 lower bound falls below -h without a point estimate below -h, the cell is NOT NEUTRAL and NOT HARMFUL: it is NON-INFERIORITY NOT PROVEN, the key does not enter the default plan, and the remedy is the configuration's own replicate (owner decision 38's first clause), not a re-read of this one.
decision_rule.efficiency_is_reported_regardless: every efficiency deliverable of section primary_deliverables is measured and reported whatever the verdict word is, including under HARMFUL. A cost measurement is not contingent on a quality outcome.
decision_rule.headroom_trigger: AN EFFICIENCY CELL DOES NOT COUNT TOWARD OWNER DECISION 30's HEADROOM TRIGGER. This cell consumes a flight slot and a share of the GPU budget; it does not consume a headroom attempt, and a NEUTRAL result here is not evidence about the bar.
decision_rule.neutral_rule: the SLURP v2 design's section 15 resolution 5 admits a NEUTRAL switch into the default plan ONLY IF IT LOWERS COST. This one does, measurably, which is the whole point of the cell. On NEUTRAL the key enters the SLURP default plan and EVERY LATER CELL AND THE TEST READ ADOPT IT; from that moment a cell registered against a sealed PER-ROLE arm is registered against a comparator that is no longer the default, and its package MUST SAY SO -- the same clause the B8a package used for the delivery node.
decision_rule.no_admitted_on_a_gain: there is no ADMITTED-on-a-gain clause. If the paired SLU delta's CI95 lower bound happens to exceed zero, that is REPORTED as a fact and explicitly NOT claimed as an effect of the rendering key: the cell has no mechanism by which constant rendering should raise quality, and a positive interval on a one-shot read is not an admission.

null_margins_pp.source: owner decision 38: a configuration's own replicate is the first margin; this cell has no replicate, so the registered FALLBACK is cell B0r's own null on this exact roster and geometry (docs/results/2026-09-17-slurp-b0-review-off-redecision-v2.md; analysis/SAEA-SLURP-B0-REPLICATE-PAIRED-ANALYSIS-V1/README.md)

decision_rule.primary: official pooled SLU micro F1 (slurp-slu-official-train), natural mixture, against the sealed anchor, as a NON-INFERIORITY guard
decision_rule.scenario_band: a scenario loses intent beyond the null band when the CI95 upper bound of that scenario's own paired intent delta is below zero. Under owner decision 17 this is a DIAGNOSTIC the verdict must carry and state, and a breach is reported as a breach; it does not by itself convert a non-inferior read into HARMFUL, which requires a roster-level measured loss.
decision_rule.secondary_gate: intent (joint scenario+action) accuracy, also as a non-inferiority guard
decision_rule.stop_condition: before any table of this read is looked at: (1) the sealed anchor comparator reproduces its own registered official aggregates to the hundredth of a point from its sealed score artifact, with the three artifact hashes re-verified by hashing the files; (2) every row is accounted for -- 1,080 in, 1,080 out, no row dropped and no sample_id invented, on both sides; (3) the roster, split identity and scenario / speaker strata are identical on both sides; (4) the sealed tool-schema-rendering receipt reports distinct_tool_schemas_sha256 == 1 on every row. If any clause fails the read STOPS and the discrepancy is reported before anything else happens.

delta_convention: delta = EFF-1 minus the sealed anchor, in percentage points; negative is worse
diagnostics_required: FINITE COMPLETIONS. The count of rows whose terminal_disposition.reason is "finite_completion", the affected sample ids, the delivered-draft versus abstention split, and -- only if the count is non-zero -- the primary official metric recomputed with those rows excluded BESIDE the registered all-rows number, which stays the number the decision rule reads. No row is ever filtered out of the scored manifest. Expected zero; the anchor side is provably zero (docs/receipts/slurp-finite-completion-exposure-v1.json).

planner_action_illegal. The flight's own count, the sample ids that carry it, and their action character counts and SHA-256 values (the form inherited from the B7a recovery note's section 8). This is the failure item E8c repaired; it is reported whether or not it is zero.

FIRST-REQUEST BYTE IDENTITY, stated honestly before contact. The first request of a row is the Perception request, and under this factor it is NOT byte-identical to the anchor's: the tools array is added to it. What IS claimed, and what the smoke proves, is (a) every REVIEWER request is byte-identical to the anchor's request at the same position of the same sample id, and (b) the perception, solver and planner requests differ from the anchor's in exactly one key, tools, with tool_choice still "none" -- i.e. {k: v for k, v in on if k != 'tools'} == off. A differing Reviewer request, or any other differing key on the three tool-free roles, is a FAILURE. A differing solver or planner request whose upstream model response differs is reported, not silently excused: greedy decoding at temperature 0 is not bitwise reproducible across batch compositions.
THE CONSTANCY TABLE per row from the sealed receipt: mode, rendered_tool_names, the five contact rows with authority_tool_names beside rendered_tool_names, and distinct_tool_schemas_sha256 == 1.

NATIVE TASK-CONTRACT CALL COUNT against the anchor's realized 1,082, and the count of tool calls emitted by a role that holds no authority (expected zero; a non-zero count is not a failure of the flight -- the rail refuses the call and the episode continues -- but it is the single most interesting behavioural consequence of showing three more roles the tool definitions, and it is reported per role).

PER-SCENARIO intent and SLU tables over all 18 scenarios, in BOTH the natural-mixture and the equal-scenario weighting, plus net harmed rows per scenario with any scenario of five or more flagged (owner decision 17) -- a diagnostic the verdict must carry, not an additional gate.
ROW ACCOUNTING: 1,080 in, 1,080 out on both sides, no row dropped and no sample_id invented.

COST: actual generation contacts against the anchor's realized 5,417 and the 11,880 ceiling; actual repeated speech seconds against the anchor's realized 15,459.76; actual FIT endpoints; GPU hours read from the serving monitor over the lease window.
efficiency_tables_required: HEADLINE EFFICIENCY: prefilled tokens per row, GPU hours per 1,080 rows, wall seconds per row, contacts per row, aggregate prefill tok/s and aggregate decode tok/s -- EFF-1 beside the anchor's own realized cost block and beside the B4b reference, with every number's source named (run manifest, flight receipts, monitor, or server.log).

PER-POSITION TABLE over the five positions perception / solver / reviewer 1 / reviewer 2 / planner: prompt tokens, prefilled tokens, cached share, generated tokens, speech-packet re-decode share and prefilled tokens per row -- EFF-1 beside the B4b reference of arms.efficiency_reference_not_an_arm, with the reference labelled as a reference on every row.
CONSTANCY: distinct_tool_schemas_sha256 per row (must be 1 on all 1,080), rendered_tool_names, and authority_tool_names per role -- from the sealed saea-native-tool-schema-rendering-v1 block.

PREFILL JOIN QUALITY: the share of contacts on which n_tokens - generated + 1 equals the client's usage.prompt_tokens. Below 100.00 % the per-role figures are reported as estimates, not measurements, and the verdict says so.
CLIENT PROMPT TOKENS per row and the per-contact delta at each of the three tool-free positions, stated as an EXPECTED RISE and explicitly not a regression.
SLOT OCCUPANCY AND UTILISATION over the lease window: mean busy slots, zero-busy share, parked fraction, mean utilisation, GPU power -- from flight receipts and monitor.jsonl.
